title: Norfolk Southern launches GeneratioNS to celebrate 200 years of moving America forward
body_markdown:
Behind every locomotive, rail line, and shipment are the railroaders who keep America moving. In 2027, Norfolk Southern will mark 200 years of that work and the generations of people who made it possible.


**Top takeaways**


- [GeneratioNS](https://www.norfolksouthern.com/200Years) **marks Norfolk Southern’s 200th anniversary** , honoring the railroaders, predecessor railroads, and communities that shaped the company and the people carrying that legacy forward.
- **The yearlong campaign will bring nearly 200 years of railroad history to life** through employee stories, digital experiences, three commemorative locomotives, and events across the network.
- **The celebrations continue throughout 2027 with the Norfolk Southern Heritage Days tour** , giving employees, customers, and communities new ways to experience Norfolk Southern’s history and anniversary locomotives up close.


This week, we kicked off the anniversary celebrations with the people at the heart of our railroad: Team NS.


Employees, leaders, retirees, and special guests gathered at our Norris Yard in Birmingham, Alabama, while teams across the network joining virtually.


The event brought our railroad’s story to life through conversations with longtime employees and stories from families with generations of service. Railroaders reflected on what has changed, what has endured, and the lessons they hope the next generation will carry forward.


###


The kickoff also featured the unveiling of Locomotive No. 4980, **The 1827** , the first of three commemorative locomotives in the **[NS 200 Locomotive Series](https://www.norfolksouthern.com/en/newsroom/story-yard/introducing-the-ns-200-locomotive-series)** . Members of our Juniata paint shop team in Altoona, Pennsylvania, shared the inspiration behind its commemorative design and the work that went into bringing it to life.


*And Birmingham is just the beginning.*


**Celebrating the GeneratioNS that built our railroad**


Our story stretches back nearly two centuries to the earliest railroads in our family tree. Those railroads helped communities grow, connected American industries with new markets, and laid the foundation for the network Norfolk Southern operates today.


That legacy lives on not only in the routes we serve, but in the knowledge passed from one generation of railroaders to the next.


Today, that work continues with every shipment, from materials delivered to manufacturers and crops carried to market to goods moving to communities across the country. As customers’ needs evolve, our railroaders continue to adapt, building on nearly 200 years of experience while preparing the railroad for what comes next.


Throughout the anniversary year, **GeneratioNS** will bring that story to life through:


- **Railroader stories:** Honoring the people, past and present, whose dedication and expertise have shaped Norfolk Southern.
- **Railroad heritage:** Exploring the predecessor railroads, milestones, and innovations that helped build today’s railroad.
- **Commemorative experiences:** Bringing the anniversary to life through specialty locomotives, digital experiences, and events across our network that honor the communities that built our railroad.


**What we're saying**


“For 200 years, railroads have been part of the backbone of America, connecting businesses and markets, strengthening our supply chain, and helping drive the nation’s economy forward,” said Norfolk Southern President and CEO Mark George. “None of that happens without the generations of railroaders who built this industry and the people carrying that legacy forward today. As we honor our past, we’re equally focused on what comes next and building a stronger railroad for our customers and the people and places we serve.”


**What’s ahead**


Beginning in spring 2027, the celebration will travel across the network with the[Norfolk Southern Heritage Days tour](https://norfolksouthern.com/200Years) , bringing employees, customers, and communities together to experience the railroad’s history and see the anniversary locomotives up close.


Each stop will take place in a community with a deep connection to our railroading heritage, celebrating the people, places and defining moments that have shaped Norfolk Southern’s story.


Event locations and additional details will be announced in the coming weeks.
